descriptionChirho: Qal active sense of carrying out a deed, action, or task — the general-purpose 'do' meaning of Aramaic ʿăḇaḏ.
Qal sense of physically making or manufacturing an object, corresponding to 'make/construct' rather than 'do/perform'.
Idiomatic Qal usage meaning to celebrate or observe a religious festival (e.g., Passover), a specialized extension of the 'do/perform' sense.
Hitpael (reflexive-passive) stem indicating that something is done, carried out, made, or executed — the passive counterpart of the active Qal senses.
